components.name: GitHub Identity Control
components.description: A borderless 44px identity action whose neutral GitHub mark fills the signed-out slot, swaps to a spinner while authorizing, and becomes a same-size real user avatar when connected.
components.css: .ds-github-identity { width: 44px; height: 44px; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; overflow: hidden; background: transparent; color: var(--text, #141414); cursor: pointer; } .ds-github-identity svg, .ds-github-identity img { width: 44px; height: 44px; display: block; } .ds-github-identity img { object-fit: cover; } .ds-github-identity:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-github-identity:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #525252); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Command Field
components.description: The centered command field combines a four-color Google mark, search or direct URL entry, shortcut hint, and submit action while keeping its outer border visually stable during input focus.
components.html: <form class="ds-search" role="search"><svg class="ds-google-mark" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path fill="#4285f4" d="M21.6 12.2c0-.7-.1-1.4-.2-2H12v3.8h5.4a4.6 4.6 0 0 1-2 3v2.5h3.2c1.9-1.8 3-4.3 3-7.3Z"/><path fill="#34a853" d="M12 22c2.7 0 5-.9 6.6-2.4l-3.2-2.5c-.9.6-2 1-3.4 1-2.6 0-4.8-1.8-5.6-4.2H3.1v2.6A10 10 0 0 0 12 22Z"/><path fill="#fbbc05" d="M6.4 13.9A6 6 0 0 1 6.1 12c0-.7.1-1.3.3-1.9V7.5H3.1A10 10 0 0 0 2 12c0 1.6.4 3.1 1.1 4.5l3.3-2.6Z"/><path fill="#ea4335" d="M12 5.9c1.5 0 2.8.5 3.8 1.5l2.9-2.9A9.7 9.7 0 0 0 12 2a10 10 0 0 0-8.9 5.5l3.3 2.6C7.2 7.7 9.4 5.9 12 5.9Z"/></svg><input class="ds-search-input" type="search" placeholder="搜索或输入网址" aria-label="搜索或输入网址"/><kbd class="ds-search-key">⌘ K</kbd><button class="ds-search-action" type="submit" aria-label="开始搜索"><svg class="ds-search-arrow" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14M14 7l5 5-5 5"/></svg></button></form>
components.css: .ds-search { width: min(760px, 100%); min-height: 54px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 7px 8px 7px 17px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #d6d6d6); border-radius: 17px; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--text-tertiary, #6b6b6b); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; } .ds-google-mark { width: 20px; height: 20px; flex: 0 0 auto; } .ds-search-input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text, #141414); font: inherit; font-size: 14px; } .ds-search-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-tertiary, #6b6b6b); opacity: 1; } .ds-search-key { padding: 4px 7px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, #e8e8e8); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--surface-muted, #fafafa); color: var(--text-tertiary, #6b6b6b); font: inherit; font-size: 10px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-search-action { width: 38px; height: 38px; display: grid; place-items: center; flex: 0 0 auto; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--accent, #171717); color: var(--on-accent, #ffffff); cursor: pointer; } .ds-search-arrow { width: 17px; height: 17px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-search-action:hover { filter: contrast(1.18); } .ds-search-action:active { transform: translateX(1px); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-search { transition: color 180ms ease-out, background-color 180ms ease-out, border-color 180ms ease-out; } }

components.name: Quick Destination
components.description: A compact grayscale destination control with a controlled semantic-color icon.
components.css: .ds-quick-link { min-height: 42px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, #e8e8e8); border-radius: 13px; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--text-secondary, #525252); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-quick-icon { width: 17px; height: 17px; display: block; flex: 0 0 auto; fill: currentColor; } .ds-quick-link:hover { border-color: var(--border, #d6d6d6); background: var(--surface-hover, #f0f0f0); color: var(--text, #141414); } .ds-quick-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #525252); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-quick-link:active { background: var(--surface-pressed, #e8e8e8); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-quick-link { transition: color 180ms ease-out, background-color 180ms ease-out, border-color 180ms ease-out; } }

components.name: Theme Icon Toggle
components.description: One standard-size rounded-square utility icon shows the current sun or moon state and switches theme on click.
components.html: <button class="ds-theme-toggle" type="button" aria-label="切换到暗色主题"><svg class="ds-theme-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4"/><path d="M12 2v2M12 20v2M4.9 4.9l1.4 1.4M17.7 17.7l1.4 1.4M2 12h2M20 12h2M4.9 19.1l1.4-1.4M17.7 6.3l1.4-1.4"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-theme-toggle { width: 36px; height: 36px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 11px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-secondary, #525252); cursor: pointer; } .ds-theme-icon { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-theme-toggle:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #f0f0f0); color: var(--text, #141414); } .ds-theme-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #525252); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Repository Filter Chips
components.description: Transparent labels become compact inversion chips when selected.
components.css: .ds-filter-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; } .ds-filter { min-height: 32px; padding: 0 11px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-secondary, #525252); font: inherit; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; } .ds-filter:hover { color: var(--text, #141414); } .ds-filter.ds-is-active { background: var(--accent, #171717); color: var(--on-accent, #ffffff); } .ds-filter:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #525252); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-filter { transition: color 180ms ease-out, background-color 180ms ease-out, border-color 180ms ease-out; } }

components.name: Information Panel
components.description: The canonical flat sheet pairs a structured heading with clipped internal separators.
components.html:
RSS 阅读

演示内容
components.css: .ds-panel { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, #e8e8e8); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--text, #141414); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; } .ds-panel-heading { min-height: 70px; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 14px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, #e8e8e8); } .ds-panel-title-group { min-width: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; } .ds-panel-icon { width: 36px; height: 36px; display: grid; place-items: center; flex: 0 0 auto; border-radius: 11px; background: var(--surface-muted, #fafafa); } .ds-panel-glyph { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-panel-glyph circle { fill: currentColor; stroke: none; } .ds-panel-title { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.25; font-weight: 720; letter-spacing: -0.012em; } .ds-panel-subtitle { display: block; margin-top: 3px; color: var(--text-tertiary, #6b6b6b); font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-tab-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 10px 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, #e8e8e8); } .ds-tab { position: relative; padding: 9px 8px 11px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text-secondary, #525252); font: inherit; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab::after { content: ""; position: absolute; right: 8px; bottom: -1px; left: 8px; height: 2px; border-radius: 2px 2px 0 0; background: transparent; } .ds-tab:hover, .ds-tab.ds-is-active { color: var(--text, #141414); } .ds-tab.ds-is-active::after { background: var(--accent, #171717); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #525252); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.description: A compact recommendation card with a repository link, semantic language accent, metadata, and an independent save toggle.

components.css: .ds-repo-card { min-width: 0; min-height: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 10px; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--text, #141414); } .ds-repo-card:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--repo-accent) 5%, var(--surface, #ffffff)); } .ds-repo-top { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-repo-mark { width: 30px; height: 30px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 9px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--repo-accent) 11%, var(--surface, #ffffff)); color: var(--repo-accent); } .ds-save { width: 30px; height: 30px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-tertiary, #6b6b6b); } .ds-save.is-saved { background: var(--repo-accent); color: #ffffff; } .ds-repo-title { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 700; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-repo-description { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--text-secondary, #525252); font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-repo-meta { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 7px; margin-top: auto; padding-top: 8px; color: var(--text-tertiary, #6b6b6b); font-size: 9px; } .ds-repo-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; display: inline-block; margin-right: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--repo-accent); }

components.name: RSS Feed Row
components.description: An interactive equal-height preview row combines a category signal, numeric index, clamped title, provenance, and directional cue.
components.css: .ds-feed-row { width: 100%; height: 100%; min-height: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 34px minmax(0, 1fr) 15px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 7px 12px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text, #141414); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-feed-row:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--item-accent) 6%, var(--surface, #ffffff)); } .ds-feed-index { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: var(--text-tertiary, #6b6b6b); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-feed-index i { width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--item-accent); } .ds-feed-copy { min-width: 0; } .ds-feed-title { display: -webkit-box; overflow: hidden; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 650; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; } .ds-feed-meta { display: block; margin-top: 3px; color: var(--text-tertiary, #6b6b6b); font-size: 9px; }

components.name: Contribution Matrix
components.description: The signature decorative matrix renders five activity intensities with compact rounded cells.
components.css: .ds-contribution-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(14, minmax(4px, 1fr)); gap: 3px; } .ds-contribution-grid span { aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-level-0 { background: var(--level-0, #e8ece9); } .ds-level-1 { background: var(--level-1, #bbf7d0); } .ds-level-2 { background: var(--level-2, #4ade80); } .ds-level-3 { background: var(--level-3, #16a34a); } .ds-level-4 { background: var(--level-4, #166534); }

narrative.overview:
XTab is a rounded grayscale command surface for geeks. Search, shortcuts, RSS, GitHub discovery, and personal GitHub context fit into one fixed desktop viewport.

Matte grayscale fields carry structure and control state; compact vivid signals identify content families, languages, destinations, and contribution intensity.

The three-stream 23 / 54 / 23 lattice remains stable from 1024 × 768 through 1440 × 900 without outer scrolling.
keyCharacteristics: Immediate command center above a calm, dense information lattice.
Matte grayscale fields with black/white inversion for structural emphasis.
Vivid color is reserved for compact semantic signals, never large surfaces.
Smooth 12–17px outer radii paired with smaller internal radii.
Dense content made scannable by hierarchy, rules, and a fixed one-screen lattice.

rules.name: The Neutral Structure, Vivid Signal Rule
rules.body: Black, white, and gray own layout, typography, controls, focus, and selection; vivid color is limited to compact content identity and data signals.

rules.name: The Small-but-Structured Rule
rules.body: Dense text stays legible through weight, line height, and contrast tiers instead of oversized headings.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces do not cast shadows; borders, inset fills, and tone changes carry structure and state.

dos: Do preserve black, white, and gray as the complete structural palette in both themes.
Do use black/white inversion sparingly for selected state, primary action, selection, and transient notice.
Do use vivid colors only for compact semantic signals such as category dots, icon wells, languages, saved state, and contribution intensity.
Do keep outer surfaces smoothly rounded in the established 12–17px range and step down only for nested details.
Do use restrained one-pixel rules and tonal layering to organize dense information.
Do keep all primary content visible in one desktop viewport at the verified target sizes.
Do keep preview, signed-out, empty, focus-visible, and reduced-motion states explicit and honest.
donts: Don't introduce wallpaper, gradients, glow, glassmorphism, or large chromatic surfaces.
Don't turn the interface into a sharp drafting grid; retain smooth corners and softened panel transitions.
Don't add shadows to manufacture hierarchy that borders and tones already provide.
Don't let auxiliary color replace hierarchy, selected state, focus, or primary action contrast.
Don't mix icon families or stroke attitudes; color is an annotation, not a new icon system.
Don't fabricate live RSS provenance, GitHub metrics, usernames, authentication, or contribution history.
